findings.title: State decisions lacked controller tests
findings.why_it_matters: Regressions in unowned-resource rejection or kubectl diff result handling could silently adopt another installation or mutate an already exact cluster despite the plan requiring local state-decision coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract pure ownership and diff-result tasks and cover absent, owned, unowned, exact, and drifted cases in the local validation playbook.
evidence: Initial review snapshot: the suite covered input and manifest-shape validation but had no cases for ownership collision or diff rc 0/1 decisions described in Unit 2 of the plan.

testing_gaps: The destructive integration cases for a stopped kubelet or deliberately blocked scrape path were not induced on the live homelab; normal complete-path and unchanged rerun behavior were verified instead.
